_readme: S446 (SkyMadrone): Grossmont's free capture under #2337/#2339 still has 15 page-claimed. Most are an A.S. or A.A. whose own combined page (law-enforcement-as-certificate-achievement, arabic-aa-certificate-achievement, media-communications-as-cert-achievement) went to its certificate alone. Read two as the capture does, to see how the page heads its degree and its certificate and whether they share one requirement list.

questions.capture_headings: How does each page head its degree and its certificate (one shared list, or a section each), and how is each title spelled?
